purpose: Create a narrow machine-readable Tier-2 replacement trigger without turning generic readiness/startup failures into whole-MicroVM replacement authority.

source_delta.service: RecoveryIntegrityError is translated to reserved exit code 86 with bounded redacted JSON; generic RuntimeError is not translated.
source_delta.contract: External deployment controller must bind exact Pod UID/resourceVersion, replace the whole Pod/Kata sandbox, prove new Pod+sandbox identities and same OCI digest, and keep ingress closed until recovery/readiness attestation.

supporting_isolated_mechanism_probe.scope: reconstructed helper semantics only; not exact full branch or product runtime
cases: RecoveryIntegrityError -> exit 86 + redacted signal + DB close
generic startup failure -> no Tier-2 reclassification
successful recovery -> existing return path preserved

primary_external_basis.kubernetes_api: list/watch is the supported change-tracking mechanism and clients must relist/recover from expired resourceVersion history
primary_external_basis.pod_lifecycle: restartPolicy Always restarts a terminated application container, which is insufficient for ClayVerse Tier-2 whole-sandbox replacement

remaining_gate: Implement and live-test the external fail-closed Pod/Kata sandbox replacer on the admitted target; prove signal observation, exact old/new identities, same OCI digest, generation advance, no blind effect replay and ingress closure until readiness.

unusual_experiment.reason: No shared immutable request/turn identity is exposed for this go trigger.
